title: Story premise EDU096: The Search Result Wears a Sponsor Badge
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: Did this position come from relevance, payment, or something else? Takeaway/theme: Placement and sponsorship are context, not proof that a claim is true or false.
description: A reader wants to understand why a result appears, but treats an advertisement and an unpaid result as identical evidence of quality. Revealing placement labels separates the source of visibility from evaluating the underlying claim.
